question: What claim is made to the twice-born about any mantra equal to this Mṛtyuñjaya?
premises: That mantra is Mṛtyuñjaya, addressed to twice-born.
inference: O twice-born, there is no mantra equal to this Mṛtyuñjaya.
uncertainties: Context of ‘by this’ points to prior mantra but is not repeated in this verse text.
plain_english: By this there is no equal mantra, O twice-born: Mṛtyuñjaya.
